description: This file provides timestamp utility functions for getting, comparing, adding, subtracting, and calculating durations with high-resolution timestamps.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current monotonic clock timestamp.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_get_realtime
methods.description: Retrieves the current real-time clock timestamp.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_cmp
methods.description: Compares two timestamps, returning 1 if first is greater, -1 if less, 0 if equal.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_subtract_ns
methods.description: Subtracts two timestamps in nanoseconds (second minus first).

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_until_ns
methods.description: Calculates nanoseconds until a given timestamp from now.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_until_us
methods.description: Calculates microseconds until a given timestamp from now.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_until_ms
methods.description: Calculates milliseconds until a given timestamp from now.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_since_ns
methods.description: Calculates nanoseconds since a given timestamp.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_since_us
methods.description: Calculates microseconds since a given timestamp.

methods.name: rdkx_timestamp_since_ms
methods.description: Calculates milliseconds since a given timestamp.
